title: React Hook Contract
description: Structural requirements for all compiled custom React hooks

rules.title: Typed Return Object
rules.description: Hook must return a typed object (not `any`, not untyped tuple). Exception: hooks that explicitly document a tuple return with named types.

rules.title: Async State Tracking
rules.description: Hooks that perform async operations (fetch, mutation) must track loading and error states and expose them in the return value.

rules.title: Stable Function References
rules.description: Functions returned from the hook must be wrapped in useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders in consumers.

rules.title: No Direct fetch() in Hook
rules.description: Data-fetching hooks must not use raw fetch() without abort controller support, or must use a library (SWR, React Query, axios with cancel token).

rules.title: Error Boundary Compatible
rules.description: Hooks must not throw unhandled promises — async errors must be caught and stored in error state.

rules.title: Single Responsibility
rules.description: Hook must serve one purpose. A hook that manages both data fetching AND UI state AND form state is a contract violation — split it.
